intent.title: Reconsider a coding agent dedicated to resolving Iaso issues

intent.readback: Challenge the design and evaluate including a coding agent in the initial issue-resolution UI. Determine how the agent and browser should cooperate to complete resolutions with a good user experience. The owner has not yet selected an integration or autonomy model.
will: Evaluate issue-scoped agent assistance and execution as an initial capability.
Explain how owner decisions, agent actions and verification connect in the UI.
Continue to focus on one project and all Iaso issue types.
wont: Treat the earlier suggestion to defer coding-agent integration as a settled exclusion.
Treat this exploration as approval of an agent architecture or autonomous execution policy.

updates.title: One project and Iaso issue resolution; agent integration remains open
updates.chosen: Resolve each kind of Iaso issue within one project. Leave general team coordination and assignments to the underlying harness. Whether to include an issue-resolution coding agent initially is reopened for design exploration.
updates.rationale: The owner selected one-project scope, then immediately clarified uncertainty about deferring coding-agent integration and asked for challenge. Integration timing and autonomy are not decided.

updates.readback: Focus on resolving all Iaso issue types within one project, including intent conflicts. Leave general team coordination and assignments to the underlying coding-agent harness. The owner initially suggested adding coding-agent integration later, then reopened that timing in the next message.
